Tesla is sending this notification to people in Austin announcing that its Cybercab robotaxi fleet has doubled.

This aligns with Texas registration data from this past week, which showed Tesla's total number of registered Cybercabs jump from 58 on Monday to 125 on Friday, a 115% increase.
